facts.fact: Black Sunday (1960)：女巫 Asa 从墓中复生后附体与自己容貌相同的后代 Katja，把两人关系说成「引诱与合并」，Katja 注定要变成她。
facts.quote: Asa understands her relationship with her descendant as one of seduction and merger, one that Katja herself has been able to feel brewing in her body for years. Asa also clearly understands Katja as subordinate to her: You were destined to become me.

facts.fact: Witchcraft (1964)：被 Lanier 家族活埋数百年的母系女巫 Vanessa Whitlock 附体年轻后代 Amy Whitlock，驱使 Whitlock 家族报复 Lanier 并杀婴献祭。
facts.quote: Only a few years later, in 1964, another Monstrous Bitch film was released, Witchcraft. In this film, an ancient matriarchal witch—Vanessa Whitlock—has been buried for hundreds of years. She was buried alive by the Lanier family.

facts.fact: The Gorgon (1964)：作者指出片中「Gorgon」Megaera 并非古典蛇发女妖 Stheno、Euryale、Medusa 之名，而是复仇女神 Fury 之一的名字，影片借此把 Gorgon、Fury 与狼人 mormolyke 混为一体。
facts.quote: Megaera is not the name of a Gorgon in ancient Greek tradition; the names of the classical Gorgons are Stheno, Euryale, and (of course) Medusa. Megaera is, in fact, the name of one of the Furies.2

facts.fact: 1966 年三部：She-Beast 的 Bardella 溺死后借车祸中的新娘还魂、片尾留下「I'll be back」；The Witch 的 Consuelo 造出女儿 Aura 作诱饵吸干 Sergio；The Witches 的 Stephanie 为换「跳舞的皮」要血祭 14 岁处女 Linda，Gwen 用己血破咒，Stephanie 死而 Gwen 与 Linda 都活。
facts.quote: But in the end, her ancient witchy monstrosity is stopped by another woman—our heroine, Gwen, who uses her own blood to stymie the possession ritual and return the world to order. Stephanie is killed in the process, but both Gwen and Linda survive.

facts.fact: The Exorcist (1973)：作者指出附体 Regan 的恶魔 Pazuzu 是 lilitu（含 Lamashtu）之王，Regan 因此成为 lilitu，故事发生在 1973 年，即 Roe v. Wade 判决那年。
facts.quote: Whether good or bad, Pazuzu is tied to Lamashtu and to her lilitu correlates and offspring. Being in the thrall of Pazuzu, Regan is a lilitu—running around the capital city of the United States in 1973, the year in which Roe v. Wade was decided.

facts.fact: Frightmare (1974)：Dorothy 用塔罗牌广告诱杀年轻女子并吃人，女儿 Debbie 继承母系嗜血；Werewolf Woman (1976) 的 Daniella 则被三百年前烧死的祖先附体，与 Favian 性交后咬颈吸血杀死他。
facts.quote: Soon, Dorothy starts luring young women to her house through ads in the papers for her tarot reading skills. Once they’re in her house, she attacks, kills, and eats them.

facts.fact: Suspiria (1977)：Suzy 发现 Helena Markos 要附体她，用刀砍下 Markos 的头并逃出崩塌的学校；作者视女性主角开始存活为本章转折点，此后转向 1970–1983 的 vampiress 子类型。
facts.quote: Hoping both to save herself and free her friend, Suzy quickly gets a knife and decapitates Markos, who is covered in dirt, hair unkempt, nails long and black. She is Erichtho: a zombie-making Greek witch with a hygiene problem, adapted for the twentieth century.

facts.fact: 作者主张 1960 年代女巫附体片是父权对第二波女性主义（1960 年口服避孕药上市、1963 年 Betty Friedan《The Feminine Mystique》出版）的反扑：父权把年轻美女写成老女巫的猎物，让女性彼此提防而不是提防父权。
facts.quote: Patriarchy wasn’t thrilled with all this clamoring for female sexual and public power, so it doubled down on depictions of women as monsters in films. And in a very clever move, in all of these films, it made young, beautiful women into the prey of older, evil women who wanted to possess and destroy them.
